      "snippet": "Short answer: add a third agent, but only when the code touches risky surfaces. Otherwise it’s overkill.
Here’s the sweet spot that fits your MVP rule:
When 2 agents are enough

Pure logic, small scripts, no file system, no schedulers, no external tools.

Builder writes → Analyst verifies → ship.

When to add a 3rd (do this by default for these cases)

Any script that:

writes files or folders, moves/renames, or rotates logs

references environment variables or prompts for secrets

schedules tas"
